description: Package a local directory (secrets and node_modules excluded) and deploy it as a new immutable release. The project root must contain a Dockerfile and the app must listen on 0.0.0.0:$PORT. Creates the project when it does not exist yet and returns the live URL. When available, release identifies the exact upload, links labels each URL, and handoff.sendToHuman names its Console review link (null when no Console review is available); applicationUrl follows whatever serves now. Apps have no outbound network access by default: set "egress": "internet" in rightside.json if the app calls external APIs (payments, LLMs, email providers, webhooks); private/LAN addresses and outbound SMTP port 25 stay blocked (use 465/587). Dotenv files are never uploaded: give the app its settings and API keys with import_env (or set_env). On failure, follow error.details.retry: idempotencyKey "reuse" means the outcome is unknown, so call again with the same idempotencyKey (it resumes or replays the original request instead of starting a second release); "new" means the release already failed, so call again without idempotencyKey or with a new one (the old key only replays that failure); waitFirst means call project_status until no operation is running before retrying.

auth.description: Opt in to hosted auth if the project has to be created. Default false.

config.description: Overrides merged over the directory rightside.json.

egress.description: 'internet' lets the running app open outbound connections to the public internet. Default 'none'.

database.description: Legacy opt-in: provision PostgreSQL if the project has to be created. Default false.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying; derived :create/:deploy keys stay within 128 characters. Generated when omitted.

name.description: Project name; defaults to rightside.json "name", then the directory name.

projectId.description: Deploy to this exact project id, skipping name lookup.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the application directory to deploy.

name: deploy_project
